mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(ci.cart_item_no) FROM cart c JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_no = ci.cart_no WHERE c.member_no = #{memberNo}

SELECT ci.cart_item_no AS cartItemNo, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, po.option_size AS optionSize, po.color AS color, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate FROM cart c JOIN cart_item ci ON c.cart_no = ci.cart_no JOIN product_option po ON ci.product_option_no = po.product_option_no JOIN product p ON po.product_no = p.product_no WHERE c.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ci.cart_item_no DESC
